entries.title: Packet Highway in a 3D Data Center
entries.description: A 3D grid of transparent server cubes connected by glowing tubes where colored packet spheres spawn, choose routes based on congestion meters, split, merge, queue, and occasionally collide or reroute around “failed” darkened nodes.

entries.title: Autonomous Drone Delivery Network Over a City
entries.description: A light-colored cityscape with buildings as boxes and flying drones as small rotating quads that follow color-coded air lanes, avoid each other with steering behaviors, dock at rooftop hubs, and reroute around temporary no-fly zones that appear as transparent red domes.

entries.title: Blood Flow Routing in Branching Arteries
entries.description: A semi-transparent branching arterial tree where red and white cell particles flow, branch at junctions based on diameter and “pressure” gauges, form clots that partially block paths, and cause cells to reroute through smaller capillary loops that glow when overloaded.

entries.title: Factory Conveyor Routing System
entries.description: A network of crossing conveyor belts and chutes that move colored boxes, where boxes are scanned by rotating sensor rings, diverted by tilting paddles, merge into main lines, pile up when blocked, and occasionally fall off into transparent collection bins.

entries.title: Rail Yard Track Switching Simulator

entries.title: Internet Router Node Galaxy
